rule: The 40 largest domestic freight flows by value between FAF zones in different states (no state in common), counting only shipments that cross a state line, between zones whose anchors are at least 250 km apart. The parts of one metro area split by a state line (e.g. New York-Newark in NY, NJ, CT and PA) are merged into one zone. Both directions are summed. Values are FAF model estimates for the year, in million current dollars and thousand short tons.
path_note: FAF gives a shipment's start and end zones, not its route: any line drawn between the two anchor cities is a drawing aid, not the way the goods travel.

commodities.19: Natural gas and other fossil products
